items.statement: The net VNB margin increased by 750 basis points year-on-year to 22.9% for the first quarter of the current fiscal year.
items.quote: The net VNB margin has improved by 750 basis points on a year-on-year basis from 15.4% for the quarter ended 30 June '25 to 22.9% for the first quarter of the current year.

items.statement: Profit after tax grew by 22.81% year-on-year to 13,492 crore rupees for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
items.quote: The profit after tax for the quarter ended 30th June '26 was 13,492 crore rupees as compared to 10,986 crore rupees for the quarter ended 30th June '25, registering a growth of 22.81% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: The solvency ratio of the corporation increased to 2.42 as of June 30, 2026, compared to 2.17 a year prior.
items.quote: The solvency ratio as on 30th June '26 improved to 2.42 as against 2.17 on 30th June 2025.

items.statement: The company's market share by first-year premium income declined to 60.10% for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, from 63.51% in the same period last year.
items.quote: Our market share by first year premium income for three months ending 30th June '26 is 60.10% as per IRDAI as compared to 63.51% for the similar period ended 30th June 2025.

items.statement: The total number of agents decreased by 2.73% year-on-year to 14,45,692 as of June 30, 2026.
items.quote: As on June 30, 2026, the total number of agents was 14,45,692 as compared to 14,86,222 as on June 30, 2025, registering a decrease of 2.73% year-on-year basis.

items.statement: The overall expense ratio increased by 16 basis points to 10.63% for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
items.quote: For the quarter ended 30th June 2026, the overall expense ratio was 10.63% as compared to 10.47% for the same period last year.

items.statement: Management expects the VNB margin to continue improving over the coming quarters, subject to the risk-free rate.
items.quote: We don't normally give a guidance, but we expect it to improve over the next few quarters as well, of course, keeping the one uncertain factor of the RFR.

items.statement: Management expects the bancassurance channel's performance to recover and exceed last year's performance in the upcoming quarters.
items.quote: We expect it to be covered up in the subsequent quarters. We will be doing much better than what we did last year.

items.statement: Management expects ULIP sales to recover once market conditions stabilize.
items.quote: Yes, ULIP, we do expect to come back when the market situation normalizes.

items.statement: The company aims to appoint at least one Bima Sakhi in every gram panchayat across India.
items.quote: Our objective is to appoint at least one Bima Sakhi in every gram panchayat, and we would like to inform that out of 244,876 gram panchayat in India, we have covered 62% gram panchayat

items.statement: Demand for ULIPs was impacted by market volatility and reduced investor confidence.
items.quote: ULIP premium reduction is naturally a function of the market scenario when confidence in the market gets affected due to the high volatility in the market functioning.

items.statement: A reduction in low ticket size policies has contributed to an increase in margins.
items.quote: The low ticket size policies have come down, no doubt. But this has helped in increasing the margins as well.

items.statement: The average ticket size has increased due to raising the minimum ticket size of major selling policies from INR 1 lakh to INR 2 lakh.
items.quote: Two, on the regular premium side also because we have increased the minimum ticket of our major selling poly from INR1 lakh to INR2 lakh that has already resulted in uptick in the average ticket size.

items.statement: The loss of input tax credit due to GST changes on individual lines has impacted the overall expense ratio.
items.quote: While the GST has gone on the individual lines and the premium, the nonavailability of input tax credit has had an impact on the overall expense ratio.

items.statement: The total expense ratio rose slightly due to the negative impact of GST input tax credit loss and other expenses.
items.quote: The remaining negative portion is largely on persistency and mortality. And the impact of expenses is 190 bps negative as both GST, ITC as well as other expenses, the total expense ratio has slightly gone up.

items.statement: The net VNB margin increased by 750 basis points year-on-year to 22.9% in the first quarter of the current fiscal year.
items.quote: The net VNB margin has improved by 750 basis points on a year-on-year basis from 15.4% for the quarter ended 30 June '25 to 22.9% for the first quarter of the current year.

items.statement: The par business segment represented 37.1% of the business and yielded a VNB margin of 19.4%.
items.quote: So if you look at the proportion of par business, which is 37.1%, which gives a VNB margin of 19.4%.

items.statement: The individual non-par segment achieved a margin of 49.3%.
items.quote: The proportion of non-par individual is INR1,678 crores, which gives a margin of 49.3%.

items.statement: LIC launched the MyLIC and Super Sales Saathi mobile applications in April 2026 as part of its digital transformation.
items.quote: The launch of MyLIC and Super Sales Saathi mobile applications in April 2026 marked a significant milestone in LIC's digital transformation journey.

items.statement: LIC has recruited Bima Sakhis in 62% of India's gram panchayats as part of its rural distribution initiative.
items.quote: Our objective is to appoint at least one Bima Sakhi in every gram panchayat, and we would like to inform that out of 244,876 gram panchayat in India, we have covered 62% gram panchayat

items.statement: LIC continues to lead the Indian life insurance market in both the individual and group business segments.
items.quote: We continue to maintain our leadership in the Indian life insurance market across both individual and group business segments.

items.statement: High market volatility poses a risk to investor confidence and ULIP premium growth.
items.quote: ULIP premium reduction is naturally a function of the market scenario when confidence in the market gets affected due to the high volatility in the market functioning.

items.statement: Fluctuations in the risk-free rate represent an uncertain factor for future margin improvements.
items.quote: We don't normally give a guidance, but we expect it to improve over the next few quarters as well, of course, keeping the one uncertain factor of the RFR.
